current: Six research objectives are addressed: a trust-centric consent model (RO1), decentralised identity and authority trust using decentralised identifiers and verifiable credentials (RO2), trustworthy multi-party authorisation through a threshold N over the guardian set G (RO3), policy- and context- aware access control (RO4), temporal and lifecycle trust with expiry and revocation (RO5), and formal security assurance with empirical validation (RO6).
